thesis_summary.thesis: AMETEK manufactures niche electronic instruments and precision electromechanical components sold into process, power, industrial, aerospace, defense, and medical end markets. **[Fact]** FY2025 net sales were a record **$7.40 billion** (+6.6% versus 2024) split between Electronic Instruments Group (**$4.92 billion**) and Electromechanical Group (**$2.48 billion**). **[Fact]** The company converts earnings to cash efficiently: FY2025 free cash flow was **$1.67 billion** on **$1.48 billion** net income. Growth is driven by the **AMETEK Growth Model**: operational excellence, strategic acquisitions, global expansion, and new product development.
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: We do not see a dated mispricing catalyst at today's price. **[Inference]** The stock trades at a scarcity premium for a proven serial acquirer with record backlog (**$3.58 billion** at year-end 2025) and mid-20s operating margins. **[Fact]** Q1 2026 sales rose **11%** year over year (roughly **5% organic**, **4% acquisitions**, **2% foreign exchange). The market may be right that quality persists; our work says the **expected annual return at ~$233** is below our ~15% hurdle even if the franchise compounds.
